name: end_sitting
description: End this sitting. If it added no paint to the painting and had a whole-canvas look and a detail crop in normal color, the painting is complete. Otherwise the next sitting starts after the break, when one is set, and this returns the message for the new sitting, its number, the painting's clock, your journal and a look at the whole canvas.

name: read
description: Read a file in this studio. PNG files return an image; other files return text. A folder returns the names of what is in it, a folder's ending in /.
